insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Total sales grew to $410 (+9.7% WoW) from $374 on 14 units. The BE YOU Sling & Stretch Strap led the week at $126 (+80.0%) on 9 units (+80.0%), with conversion climbing to 17.3% (+86.9%). The Purple and Blue BE YOU Yoga Mats each added $89, PPC revenue rose to $283 (+36.2%), and Sunday, Nov 15 was the peak day at $117.

**Metrics to Watch —** The BE SECURE Hot Yoga Towel in Dark Gray eased to $76 (-66.7%), driven primarily by fewer sessions (65, -14.5%) and a 3.1% conversion rate. Organic revenue came in at $127 (-23.5%) as a larger share of sales arrived through ads, and daily sales tapered to $14 on both Fri Nov 20 and Sat Nov 21. The overall week still grew +9.7%, and we are focused on bringing traffic back to the towel line and lifting late-week volume.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** ROAS improved to 0.54x from 0.45x, with PPC revenue up +36.2% to $283 on ad spend of $528 (prior $463). TACoS sits at 128.8% (prior 124.01%) and ACOS at 186.6%, with a 0.21% ad CTR and a 3.50% ad conversion rate. Spend was set to build discovery across the mat and towel range; we are now concentrating budget on the converting Sling & Stretch Strap and cutting non-converting terms to bring ACOS down.

**Actions This Week —** Shift budget toward the BE YOU Sling & Stretch Strap, which converted at 17.3% on 9 units, to scale its +80.0% growth. Pause or lower bids on search terms with clicks and no orders to bring ACOS down from 186.6% and lift ad conversion above 3.50%. Launch an ad creative test on the Dark Gray Hot Yoga Towel to lift ad CTR above 0.21% and rebuild its 65 sessions.
